title: Ford GT in the Night Studio Above the City
label: MIDNIGHT GARAGE
statement: Silence the noise. Do the work.
description:
Up here in the Night Studio, a giallo yellow Ford GT sits peacefully in the calm room. Outside, you can watch the city glittering far below while the screens glow low. Mellow jazzy keys and a soft head-nod beat fill the air with two hours of music-only lo-fi hip hop. It is the perfect corner of the world for you to work, study, or gently relax.

No talking. No lyrics. No sudden sounds. Every track is original, made for CEO Focus.

CEO Focus | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.
